searchText: **EIPIP Meeting 92** Date and Time: Oct 18, 2023 at 14:00 UTC Agenda: https://github.com/ethereum-cat-herders/EIPIP/issues/281 Zoom Meetinghttps://us02web.zoom.us/j/82357016731?pwd=V0hLUWIvU2V2UTdUd216WHdGNFBKUT09 Summary - https://github.com/ethereum-cat-herders/EIPIP/issues/281#issuecomment-1768740036 Missed the call for the RollCall L2 call. I am disappointed about the merged website decision. What I thought the agreement was for is two separate websites, one for EIPs and one for ERCs. Two different top level domains, two different repos. I'll have to watch the video to see how this decision came to be. sites were notionally eip.ethereum.org, erc.ethereum.org, <wg>.ethereum.org, for example for RIPs rip.ethereum.org RollCall (the L2 call) is interested in a separate rollup topic/working group. yeah i don't understand, we talked about this last EIPIP and I thought we already agreed on the separate website? from eipip 91 https://github.com/ethereum-cat-herders/EIPIP/issues/278#issuecomment-1747725103 > The subdomain erc.ethereum.org is ready. Just waiting to set up the correct files. seemed pretty clear?

**EIPIP Meeting 92**
Date and Time: Oct 18, 2023 at 14:00 UTC
Agenda: https://github.com/ethereum-cat-herders/EIPIP/issues/281

excerpts.author: _shemnon
excerpts.content: Missed the call for the RollCall L2 call.  I am disappointed about the merged website decision.  What I thought the agreement was for is two separate websites, one for EIPs and one for ERCs.  Two different top level domains, two different repos.  I'll have to watch the video to see how this decision came to be.

excerpts.author: _shemnon
excerpts.content: sites were notionally eip.ethereum.org, erc.ethereum.org, <wg>.ethereum.org, for example for RIPs rip.ethereum.org

excerpts.author: _shemnon
excerpts.content: RollCall (the L2 call) is interested in a separate rollup topic/working group.

excerpts.author: lightclient
excerpts.content: yeah i don't understand, we talked about this last EIPIP and I thought we already agreed on the separate website?

excerpts.author: lightclient
excerpts.content:

seemed pretty clear?
